title: The brain carries at least eight enforced Go records and five enforced Python records
body:
Why: Fable direction 1115e slice 2. Go has one record, Python three.
Outcome: >=8 enforced Go records (gofmt, vet, go.sum committed, wrapped errors, no library panic, tests beside code, context first, pinned toolchain) and >=5 enforced Python (pinned dependencies, type-check config, linter, no bare except, src layout) in standards/records.json.
Proof: red and green fixtures per record; audit on one public Go clone without a lane, zero false-red; krn adopt --init go and python still 0 FAIL. Free.
